messages.content:
I have created a personal portfolio site with a modern design, interactive animations, and responsive layouts.

### 🌐 Live Preview
You can preview your site right now at:
👉 **[Open Live Portfolio Preview](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/fe0778dd-8aaf-484f-96be-11a695aa0491/39fc836dac00e21ed129fec6/)**

---

### ✨ Features Included

1. **Hero & Brand Identity**
   - **Status Badge:** Live availability indicator (🟢 *"Available for new opportunities"*).
   - **Interactive Code Window:** Glassmorphic card displaying a TypeScript developer configuration with subtle floating animation.
   - **Key Metrics Grid:** Highlight counters for years of experience, shipped applications, open-source reach, and user impact.
   - **Quick Actions:** Direct project jump, contact CTA, and a 1-click email copy button with toast notification.

2. **Featured Projects & Case Studies**
   - **Filter Tabs:** Filter projects by category (*All Works*, *AI & Automation*, *Full-Stack Systems*, *Frontend & Tools*).
   - **Visual Vector Mockups:** Custom SVG illustrations for each project.
   - **Detailed Case Study Modal:** Click *"View Case Study"* on any project card to open an architecture breakdown with problem statements, solutions, metrics, and technology tags.

3. **Tech Stack & Interactive Skill Search**
   - Categorized by **Frontend & UI**, **Backend & Cloud**, and **Architecture, AI & DevOps**.
   - **Live Search Filter:** Instant filter input allowing visitors to find specific technologies (e.g. *React*, *Go*, *Docker*).

4. **Career Journey & Education Timeline**
   - Clean milestone timeline with roles, companies, dates, impact summaries, and tech tags.
   - Education block featuring degree, honors, and a CV download action.

5. **Testimonials & Endorsements**
   - Endorsement cards from engineering managers and founders with star ratings and quotes.

6. **Interactive Contact Section**
   - Functional contact form with validation and simulated submission with toast feedback.
   - Direct connection card with instant clipboard copy for your email.

7. **Theme Switcher & Live Customizer Drawer**
   - **Dark / Light Mode:** Persistent theme toggle with smooth transitions.
   - **Live Customizer (🎨 button):** Real-time theme accent color picker (*Electric Indigo, Emerald, Neon Cyan, Royal Violet, Sunset Rose, Cyber Amber*) plus live input fields to preview custom names and titles immediately.

---

### 📁 File Structure

- [index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html) — Semantic HTML5 markup, responsive layouts, and modal windows.
- [assets/css/styles.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/css/styles.css) — Theme variables, glassmorphism, animations, and toast notification styles.
- [assets/js/data.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/js/data.js) — Single configuration file containing all personal details, projects, skills, and timeline items for easy editing.
- [assets/js/main.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/js/main.js) — Interactive scripts for theme switching, filtering, modals, search, and the ambient particle canvas.
- [assets/images/](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/images/) — Vector mockups for featured projects.

> [!TIP]
> To customize your information (bio, projects, skills, or links), simply update [assets/js/data.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/js/data.js) and the changes will update automatically.
